ECL should be retained as the reference anchor for restaurant sanitation, food-safety programs, QSR chain compliance, and service-density economics, but not as the main underfollowed discovery candidate.

NEOG is a plausible underfollowed QA/testing gate for the restaurant ecosystem through food-safety diagnostics and sanitation monitoring; direct restaurant/QSR or distributor customer evidence is required before promotion.
RTO/Steritech is a strong node-relevance candidate for restaurant third-party audits and brand-protection QA, but public-market purity and materiality of Steritech inside Rentokil must be verified.
ACNT remains a speculative shadow lead: HI&I and specialty chemical service-model evidence exists, but no restaurant/foodservice revenue proof was found in this pass.

ECL should remain the reference benchmark for restaurant-adjacent sanitation, hygiene, food safety, and institutional cleaning exposure, but it is too obvious/high-attention for the main underfollowed lane.

ACNT remains a speculative_shadow candidate: cached evidence supports specialty chemicals, HI&I, regulatory support, formulation, blending, logistics, and a sub-USD-300M market-cap exception, but no direct restaurant exposure has been proven.

summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expanded the direct public-company universe for restaurant sanitation, food-safety QA, and specialty chemical support. The reference lane is Ecolab, the obvious restaurant cleaning/sanitation/service leader. The underfollowed lane contains Neogen for food-safety testing and sanitation verification, Hawkins for specialty chemicals/water-treatment/food-grade ingredients with possible foodservice-adjacent exposure, and Ascent Industries as a speculative micro-cap HI&I specialty-chemical lead whose restaurant exposure is not yet established. No buy/sell view is implied. Expanded the universe around restaurant sanitation, food-safety QA, warewash, institutional cleaning, pest/compliance, and specialty chemical support.
